description_en: Modifies the auto-renewal settings of an instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库RDS实例的自动续费配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-instance-auto-renewal-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-bp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 幂等性令牌，由客户端生成（ASCII字符，最大长度64）
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of months for auto-renewal. Valid values: 1 to 12.

This parameter must be specified when AutoRenew is set to True
parameters.help_zh:
续费周期（单位：月），取值：1~12。
当AutoRenew=True时必须传入此参数
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

True
False
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭自动续费。取值：
True：开启。
False：关闭
parameters.name: auto_renew
